subject: Recap & intake: audit artifacts, DPA & retention - NorthShore Bank
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Mike Collins <mike.collins@northshore.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, security@northshore.com
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & intake: audit artifacts, DPA & retention - NorthShore Bank

Hi Mike / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick post-call recap so we have alignment and clear next steps from the security/compliance side. I tried to capture the pain areas and what we agreed to follow up on. Please correct anything I missed.

Key pain points you called out:
- Audit log coverage gaps for multi-region replicas and third-party connectors (important for your internal audit).
- DPA language around data residency and subprocessor lists; legal wants a redlineable starting point.
- Retention policy enforcement across archived buckets and cold storage (we discussed automated retention + legal hold exceptions).
- Pen test window and acceptable scope for external vendors — you prefer a short list of requirements and a 2-week window in May.

Goals we agreed to (what success looks like):
1) Provide a DPA draft + redline checklist to NorthShore legal by 3/18.
2) Deliver a minimal artifact bundle for your SOC2 readiness review (audit policy, retention config, sample logs) within 7 business days.
3) Align on pen test requirements and proposed windows; aim to lock a date by 3/21.

Requests / agreed artifacts (action items for Redwood):
- Redwood: share DPA draft (initial) and a short redline guide (Jasmine) — attached: redwood_dpa_draft_v1.pdf
- Redwood: provide audit-log field map + example export of event types for retention mapping — attached: audit-log-field-map.csv
- NorthShore: share current retention policy + point-of-contact for legal (Mike/Sarah)
- NorthShore: confirm preferred pen test vendor constraints and blackout dates

Logistics / timing:
- Proposed follow-up: 30-minute sync week of 3/17 to review artifacts and next steps (I created a tentative slot on Wed 3/19 - let me know if that works).
- Delivery windows above assume we have access to the retention policy doc and the legal POC.

Attachments (sent): redwood_dpa_draft_v1.pdf, audit-log-field-map.csv

Thanks — happy to jump on another call if helpful.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Mike Collins <mike.collins@northshore.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: security@northshore.com, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@northshore.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 15:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap & intake: audit artifacts, DPA & retention - NorthShore Bank

Hi Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear recap. This matches our notes. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- For the audit logs, we primarily need schema for the following event classes: auth, admin-config, data-access, connections. Your field map is helpful — we'll validate against our SIEM ingestion rules.
- Legal would prefer the DPA redline instead of a checklist; we'll do an initial pass and return edits.
- Pen test: we want to restrict external vulnerability scanners from hitting cardholder data processors directly — we can provide a short vendor-safe list.

I've attached what we can share now: NSB_Audit_Retention_Policy_v2.pdf and an infra diagram (sanitized) so you can confirm covered systems.

I can confirm a 2-week target for artifact delivery is fine on our side. Let's plan the follow-up call for Wed 3/19 09:30 PT if that slot still works for you.

Attachments: NSB_Audit_Retention_Policy_v2.pdf, infra-topology-diagram.png

Thanks,
Mike
Head of Compliance
NorthShore Bank
mike.collins@northshore.com
